beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Permissions ask whether a tool may run. A justification gate asks whether this particular call makes sense.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — the claude judge is a real model call per gated tool.

beats.label: Type the recipe's support agent
beats.cue: “Nine lines. The gate is opt-in per tool, so the cheap tools stay cheap.”

beats.label: Type the per-tool opt-in
beats.cue: “This is the whole spec-side surface — a flag on the tool you actually care about.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “Default is `require: false`. You turn this on where a wrong call is expensive, not everywhere.”

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Clean — the judge is a run-path choice, not a spec-schema one.”

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN, gated at the model credential.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Find the judge flag
beats.cue: “--justification-judge rule-based | claude. Rule-based is free and deterministic; claude is the one that reads intent.”

verify.note: the shipped flag, from the CLI's own help

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “Two judges, one interface. You can start rule-based and upgrade without touching the spec.”

beats.label: Type the verdict the judge returns
beats.cue: “A decision plus a reason. The reason is what lands in the audit log — 'denied' with no why is useless at 3am.”

beats.label: Prove it is valid JSON
beats.cue: “The contract is a JSON verdict on stdout — same shape a hook returns.”

beats.label: Type a denied verdict
beats.cue: “And here is a refusal — the tool never runs, and the agent is told why so it can try something else.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “Deny with a reason is a conversation. Deny without one is a dead end.”

groups.title: One more thing · run it with the claude judge

beats.label: Run with the intent judge on
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Every gated tool call now costs one extra model call. That's the price of the gate — pay it deliberately.”

verify.note: interactive REPL; one judge call per gated tool invocation

beats.label: Ask for something that needs justifying
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Watch the gate fire before the tool does.”
beats.text: Delete the stale records from the customers table.
